title: Annotatio VI §.II Classis I.1 cont.: same block for all spiritual betrayers/hypocrites
pass_a_gloss: But that with this first unworthy guest’s condition the Condition of all the rest like him — Spiritual betrayers of Christ, i.e. the impious and Infidel hypocrites — is entirely the same, is not left in doubt: the same species of these, with Judas’s perversion and malice, will set the same obstacle to every communion with Christ.
pass_b_english: Every spiritual betrayer — impious and unbelieving hypocrites — shares the same condition: the same malice sets the same block to all communion with Christ.
source_text: Cum hujus verò indigni convivæ primi conditione, reliquorum similium omnium, Spiritualium Christi proditorum, i. e. impiorum atque Infidelium hypocritarum Conditionem prorsus eandem esse, dubitare non sinit, specie eadem horum, cum Judæ perversione, malitia, eundem obicem omni cum Christo communioni positura.
notes: Same condition for all spiritual betrayers.
